text: The agent recommends coding this Datavault Software invoice to account 6350 (Software Subscriptions), cost centre CC4440, with 95% confidence, based on comparable recent invoices from Ledgerly Technologies, Vantix Analytics and Nimbusly Cloud for August 2026 API usage overage, all coded to 6350. Note that $48,528.33 of September 2026 service was not accrued at close and will land in October. Because this exceeds the $25,000 materiality threshold, it has been reported to Record-to-Report as out-of-period expense, and the invoice requires approval from Laura Gallagher (Director).
